• "Save failed" on edit: Reload the page (sticky toast says "Conflict — reload required"). Someone else saved changes since you opened the dashboard.
  • Live preview is empty: The report ran but returned 0 rows for the current user's sharing context. The widget will still save; data appears in Viewer when the underlying data exists.
  • Filters disabled: The + Filter button is disabled until at least one chart widget exists — filters need a report context to validate against.
  • Tile shows "Auto visual" placeholder: The chart hasn't picked a renderable visualization yet. Edit the widget and pick an explicit chart type from the icon grid.
